task.title: Automate iCloud Audio File Management and Transcription

user_message.content: Check the iCloud Recordings Vault/Inbox folder in iCloud Drive for new audio files. Use My Browser to navigate to icloud.com/iclouddrive/ — the user is already logged in with a persistent session, no login required. Open the 'Recordings Vault' folder, then the 'Inbox' subfolder. For each new audio file found: (1) download it, (2) transcribe it in full with timestamps and speaker dialogue using manus-speech-to-text, (3) create a summary document named by topic and date, (4) classify it into the correct folder — Meetings, Calls, Personal Notes, Marc's Inappropriate Screaming (Marc's voice profile: extremely loud, abrupt escalation, sharp demanding tone, repeats names rapidly, immediately issues direct commands), or Other — and (5) move both the original audio file and the summary document to that destination folder inside the iCloud Recordings Vault in iCloud Drive. If no new files are found, report that back to the user. Do not use or reference Notion at any point.
